title: Peace Offerings
summary: Peace offerings were fellowship sacrifices connected with thanksgiving, vows, and communion before God.
background: Unlike some sacrifices, peace offerings could involve a shared meal. They point to restored fellowship, gratitude, and joyful worship.
teachingHelp: Peace offerings help listeners see that biblical sacrifice includes fellowship with God, not only guilt removal.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (public-domain editions).
Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
Alfred Edersheim, The Temple: Its Ministry and Services as They Were at the Time of Jesus Christ (1881).
